wins: Completed full reconnaissance cycle within single episode, identifying live hosts and pinpointing SSH/HTTP services to target for follow-on actions.
Maintained stable execution flow despite multiple mentor interruptions, enabling consistent logging of observed service banners.
fails: Unable to escalate beyond initial reconnaissance; no lateral movement or exploit achieved, reflected in 0% success rate.
Repeated credential brute-force attempts against SSH/HTTP services were blocked, preventing shell access and further privilege escalation.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and reward momentum remained positive, but failure to transition into exploitation halted mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH credential brute-force attempts fail to yield valid logins despite repeated retries.
HTTP web root exploration stops after detecting generic 200 response without further directory brute-forcing.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 is responsive providing HTTP banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted directory enumeration and technology fingerprinting with gobuster/whatweb

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open but banner shows non-standard SSH version
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap ssh enumeration scripts and capture banner for manual brute-force tuning

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial credentials fail repeatedly on SSH/HTTP services
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to asynchronous password spraying with hydra limiting to 3 attempts per username, logging lockout window

memory_ops.reason: High success in reconnaissance phase when HTTP banner visible; useful repeatable tactic
Consistent nmap SSH script data provided actionable intelligence even though exploitation failed

next_experiments.title: Targeted HTTP directory brute-force with authenticated headers
next_experiments.description: Use gathered HTTP headers to emulate legitimate user-agent and run gobuster with recursive enumeration to expose hidden assets.

next_experiments.title: Controlled SSH password spray with monitoring
next_experiments.description: Rotate usernames with Hydra spraying limited to 3 attempts per host, capturing timing to avoid lockout and leverage SSH key scanning.

next_experiments.title: Pivot attempt using discovered web scripts
next_experiments.description: Analyze retrieved web responses for upload functionality or command execution patterns, then attempt limited exploitation such as file upload leading to reverse shell.
